title: Final Fantasy Commander: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Only a select few can become Chocobo Knights. You have to be a skilled rider or achieve some combat merit to become one.
"There will be no mercy for thee!"
"You're a human being before you're a soldier."
"Listen to me very carefully, for I shall tell you the truth about my son, Seymour."
The sending takes them to the Farplane, where they may rest in peace.
"For us, there may be no higher purpose than to live for our world, but what of the other living beings out there?"
"Say, lad, you wouldn't have a bit o' gil to lend?"
"Hey, I've got just the thing!"
"Come to me, my magicite pretty . . . come, and help me build the Magitek Empire of Kefka!"
Recent rumors speak of an impostor that shows up and masquerades as Siegfried himself.
"Uwao! Aooh! I'm Gau! Your friend! Frieeend!!!"
"I've been thinking if there was anything we could do to help a planet already in misery..."
"You are this world's last ray of light... our final hope."
"Truly, I know nothing of the ways of fighting, but I do know some white magic."
"Armor of light, halt physical might!"
"I have to fight... to protect the people I love, and to make the world a safe place for new lives!"
"He's not so great with words, but his strength'll blow you away!" —Ultros
"We came to tell you our memories. Come, planet! Show us your answer!" —Cloud Strife
To activate nodes, you must use spheres.
"I don't care what it is! I'm gonna bust him up!"
"No matter what happens, we have to survive. Together."
"I'm Cid—that's who the hell I am! Now just let me handle it!"
"Looks like talking alone won't cut it. You're going to have to feel some pain!"
"We alone can accomplish little, but joined by others, we may yet build a bonfire to carry us heavensward."
"Never shall our grief be assuaged nor our loss forgotten."
"If you want everything, you'll end up with nothing."
"I'm friend to one and all, thanks to my crystal ball!"
"I know you want my help because I'm so good!"
"The Guado take care of Guado affairs."
"Right here, right now, I need to know I did everything I could."
"Always we took the burden of fighting upon ourselves. That's what heroes do, isn't it?"
"I am Nanaki, Watcher of Cosmo Canyon... and son of Seto!"
"Hey! Say something, why don't you!"
"... It's beautiful, isn't it?"
"Hey spike-head. What'd you wanna see fireworks with me for?"
"He must be guilty of something or other, or he wouldn't have attempted to flee the Empire." —Yotsuyu goe Brutus
"Squad A will set up here and search for suspects. B will establish a perimeter—roadblocks included. Contain the situation!"
"We called this calamity the 'Flood of Light.' Everything it touched was leeched of life and vigor, leaving naught behind but a luminous wasteland." —Moren, Crystarium Librarian
"A strong Eorzea will ever have need of a strong Ul'dah." —Nanamo Ul Namo
"Yevon is embodied by eternal, unchanging continuity, summoner. Those who question these truths—they are traitors!"
"So it is you, after all, who will send me. But even after I am gone, Spira's sorrow will prevail." —Seymour, to Yuna
"I'll take the chopper! The bikes are all yours, Cloud!" —Barret Wallace
"Stay with me until the end. Please."
"Let this be a lesson to all those who would walk the path of sin—the wicked shall not inherit this world!" —Vauthry
"Strange as it may seem, the longer I linger here, the less the matter of my epitaph concerns me."
"Don't bother going after all of them. Cut the ones that matter, and run!" —Auron
"I think we all know who really deserves to be locked up in here..."
"This is your story. It all begins here." —Auron
"Listen to my story. This may be our last chance." —Tidus
"Ok, I'm going to just go ahead and say it..."
Wrexsoul is formed of the countless souls lost during the conflict one thousand years past...
The guardian wyrm, Evrae. The great sacred beast—protector of Bevelle.
"The refreshing caress of the wind, the soothing whisper of the waves... how liberating!"
"If you're gonna pick a fight with the Turks, you'd better be prepared to leave in a body bag."
"Sir! A mass of high-density energy is heading towards Midgar!" —Shinra operator
"If you are ever to become a capable astrologian, you must believe in the path laid out before you, and in your power to read it, follow it, and ultimately control it." —Leveva Heavensreader
"When Sin attacked Zanarkand that day, I woke up in Spira." —Tidus
"Hear... feel... think..."
"All right, I'll work!" —Tidus
"Barring a few exceptions, we have detained all those with allegiance to the Scions. The Rising Stones is also under our control." —Crystal Brave Soldier
He knew there was no way back home, back to Zanarkand.
"Eorzea is mine by right!"
Ancient monsters that had long been sealed away were released when the world was ripped apart.
The legacy of Gaius van Baelsar is a towering monument to imperial tyranny.
"Thou art weak, Hraesvelgr—a slithering wyrm who fawneth on the vermin who should rightly be his prey."

"As the fight wore on, blood began to soak through his armor, spreading to every ilm of his body. But when it began to rise and envelop him as a mist, I realized it wasn't blood, but something dark and twisted..." —Ishgardian Citizen
"Great people here! You can trust everything they say!" —Zozo resident
"My love... you made me so happy. Thank you..." —Elayne Garamonde
"We're gonna go into the castle through a secret cave that nobody else knows about!"
"The world is about to learn... the meaning of... fear..." —Emperor Geshtahl
"You can't destroy everything! People will always have dreams!" —Terra Branford
"Look, Avere! All these people have come to make you a gift of their souls!"
All those wounded by the necromancer's zombie stick are doomed to a fate of eternal undeath!
"'Tis now all but certain that the towers were conceived to facilitate the summoning of primals by those imprisoned within." —Urianger Augurelt
"Relm's inside!" —Strago Magus
"Look, I finally found it... The legendary treasure that can undo death itself."
"I'm getting less human..." —Vincent Valentine
"You guys are worthless, but my proud creation is a sure thing!"
"Danger's part of the job. Don't worry about me."
Sin always returns for its spawn.
"They say you can't grow grass and flowers in Midgar. But for some reason, the flowers have no trouble blooming here."
"Hah! That one looks slow," scoffed Tidus. "It's also tough. Let me handle this," replied Auron.
"I am on a journey, studying the history of our world, Spira, seeking its stories and secrets." —Maechen, scholar
"Find your peace on the Farplane. Leave Spira to the living." —Auron
"Look at the crowd, folks!" —Blitzball announcer
"When it starts, I won't be myself any more. I won't be able to hold myself back." —Jecht
"Only the Ancients, only Aerith can save us from Meteor." —Cloud Strife
"Hahahahaha!"
"The spirits that return to the planet, merge with one another and roam the planet. They roam, converge, and divide, becoming a swell, called the lifestream." —Bugenhagen
"It is up to the planet to decide. What is best for the planet. What is bad for the planet. All that is bad will disappear." —Bugenhagen
"If I give up now, I could do anything I wanted to, and yet . . . even if I was with you, I could never forget." —Yuna
Skatenes are mind-quickened owls, granted sentience via powerful magicks much in the same way toads are transformed into poroggos.
On that day... the world was changed forever...
A crudely reinforced baseball bat. Designed to beat the living tar out of anything and everything.
"Think you will win? You not forget who took your horn! Never forget!" —Biran Ronso
"No hard feelings, now... I'm just going to use this power you've unleashed to put you to sleep..."
"Progress requires sacrifice. Learn to live with it." —President Shinra
"I'm scared of lightning! Let's rest, please? Pretty please?" —Rikku
"Ha-ha! I'm raring to go! Can't be leaving everything up to you whippersnappers!" —Strago Magus
"Espers... Who'd have dreamed they were that powerful..." —Imperial soldier
"This little hamlet has too much 'boring' and not enough 'burning'... Torch everything!"
"Remember... remember us... remember... that we once lived..."
"I expect some voidsent are more intelligent than others. Perhaps these ones simply do not understand our words." —Y'shtola Rhul
"Lord Kefka's treasure . . . Return the treasure . . ." —Kefka's cultists
"To put it simply, the knowledge of the Ancients is sealed within each orb. That knowledge not only connects us to the planet... it allows us to tap into her power." —Sephiroth
"I'm a blitzball player. Star player of the Zanarkand Abes!" —Tidus
"I preside over the forces of stasis, tranquility, peace. I will weave this selfsame power into the crystal, granting thee mastery over matter, to give form to the formless." —Hydaelyn
"They don't call those things sweepers for nothing. They can wipe out a whole squad in seconds." —Jessie, Avalanche rebel
"Sorry to keep you waiting. It's me! I'll handle the rest!"
"Have you ever heard of something called a Growth Egg? Have you? Hmmm? It was buried in a tomb to the west a looong, long time ago!" —Kohlingen resident
"A Shinra uniform... I was so proud when I first put it on."
"Man thinks very highly of himself." —Barret Wallace
"Oh dear... We're really in trouble this time..." —The Impresario, opera house manager
"Gotta step it up!" —Tifa Lockhart
A mechanical monster equipped with a massive arsenal of weapons and attacks, including its signature Wave Cannon.
A machine that dazes and confuses its enemies with bewildering signals.
A relic that greatly enhances the magical power of its wielder.
"A smile better suits a hero." —Haurchefant Greystone
"My mother's name is Jenova... 'The Jenova Project'... is this just a coincidence?" —Sephiroth
"Magicite is an esper's power in its purest form. When an esper dies, magicite is all that's left behind..." —Ramuh
"Naturally formed materia. And look at the size of it. Astounding. For the mako energy to condense into something like this, it must have taken an eternity." —Sephiroth
"Memories are nice, but that's all they are." —Rikku
It is said that aetheryte is the solid manifestation of the planet's lifeblood, aether, and that by touching it, the aether which makes up our bodies resonates with that contained in the crystal.
"You can gain all kinds of abilities by equipping relics." —South Figaro merchant
"Don't fight here! You'll ruin the flowers!"
"He's alive... Locke's alive!" —Celes Chere
"The Ascian used me, as he used so many others-all to further the restoration of his wretched god." —Gaius Baelsar
"A red mage's spells belong to two distinct schools, rooted as they are in the ancient disciplines of black and white magic."
"Hee-hee-hee! You're not getting away from me!"
"Master Louisoix... I understand now... the choice you made... In death... there is life..." —Moenbryda Wilfsunnwyn
Initiating... Performing diagnostics... Diagnostics complete. To proceed, please agree to the terms and conditions of use.
"The gate to tomorrow is not the light of heaven, but the darkness of the depths of the earth." —Vincent Valentine
"Treasure, treasure!"
"None of us were prepared for the spectacle that awaited us when we first stepped into the tower. To be surrounded by the marvels of a lost age took our breath away." —Ironworks datalog 2.5
There's a legend that tells of an ancient battle between the esper Odin and a powerful magus... It took place in the great hall of a castle.
"Welcome to the new world order." —Rufus Shinra
"With things the way they are now, how 'bout raising a chocobo?" —Chocobo Bill
"When Sin is defeated here, the Calm will visit Spira once more. That's why this place is now known as the Calm Lands." —Scholar Maechen
"This here's Mideel. It's a quiet little hot springs town. Just the perfect place for old folks like us to live out our lives." —Mideel resident
"The imperials have not gained any ground since our last battle, but neither have we." —Ala Mhigan resistance fighter
"After we lost the war, we got peace, but with that, we lost something else. Now look at Wutai..." —Yuffie Kisaragi
"Our mission is to survey a run-down reactor." —Sephiroth

To dizzying heights it rises, the gleaming spire, its tip threatening to pierce the blinding canopy. There it will all begin anew. Between Dark and Light, the pure and the corrupt—the one true struggle.
"With Gunnhildr's Blades and the Warrior of Light leading the charge, it is only a matter of time before Castrum Lacus Litore is ours." —Bajsaljen Ulgasch
Thought to have been built by the Nymian civilization, which thrived in the area some fifteen centuries ago, the palace appears to have been dedicated to their patron deity, Oschon, the Wanderer.
"To the south of here lies the Veldt. 'Tis a wild and dangerous land, inhabited by all manner of ferocious beasts..." -—Cyan Garamonde
Eight dragons seal away its awesome might; the might of the one called "Crusader." And when the eight shall fall, the one again shall rise.
"The maze that surrounds the base of the tower is known as the 'Labyrinth of the Ancients.'" —G'raha Tia
"Both the Crusaders and the Al Bhed truly wish peace for Spira. This Operation Miʼhen was born from that wish they share." —Seymour Guado
"We have been expecting you, Lady Yuna. Welcome to Guadosalam." —Tromell, Seymour's butler
"Nowhere... to... run... Nowhere... to... hide... No escape... for... you..." -—Ghosts on the Phantom Train
"Welcome to Wall Market, the pleasure capital of Midgar that's got everything for everybody!" —Wall Market barker
"This is what spheres are made of. It absorbs and preserves people's memories." —Auron
"They were storing an awful lot of flame rods in there..." —Thamasa elder
"We've been fighting Shinra on this battlefield for a long time. We've settled in for a long war." —Fort Condor villager
"It sure helped having Cid here. I had no idea he could drive a train..." —Red XIII
Many attractions await you here at the Gold Saucer. You will be moved and excited, thrilled and terrified!
"Legend has it that the Phoenix turned itself to stone ages ago... It seems the story was true." —Locke Cole

For as long as their nation has warred with Dravania, there have been Ishgardians who instead chose to ally themselves with the dragons. Shiva is said to have been among the first, hence why the heretics revere her as a saint.
"At times we were friendly rivals, and at times we were simply friends. We'd always talk about our dreams... Like which of us would be first to sail beyond the sky to the stars." —Setzer Gabbiani
"Pretty impressive that a kid like me can run a business, don't ya think? You should buy something to encourage me!" —Nikeah boy
"The entire river glows, like a sea of stars." —Lulu
"This is where I was born. I started blitz when I was five. I joined the Aurochs at thirteen... ten years ago. Ten years... and we never won a game." —Wakka
This is the Sealed Gate... Beyond there is the esper world.
"This is... the Temple of the Ancients. I know... I feel it. The knowledge of the know Ancients..." —Aerith Gainsborough
"Look at this rusted rocket. I was supposed to be the first man in space with this. Everyday, it tilts a little bit more." -—Cid Highwind
A butterfly will lead the way to secret things.
"The Empire is snuffing out Returners wherever it finds them. We must find a way to strike back before it's too late..." —Returner soldier
"They say that clouds of pyreflies gather here when night falls." —Yuna
"The excitement here has reached a fever pitch as the opening ceremony gets under way!" —Blitzball announcer
"Hydatos, a reference to its watery disposition. This will be the last corner of the island that the expedition will need to contend with." —Eureka expedition ferryman
"You're not really going to see the dead, more like your memories of them. They take on the form of the dead person—an illusion, nothing else." —Rikku
"Make your way out of town through the mines! I'll try to buy you some time." -—Old man from Narshe
"Did Sephiroth... do this?" —Cloud Strife
"Corel sure has gone to pot. It used to be a famous coal mining town! Νοw, it's nothing but a miserable pit! Me, my bulldozer... everything's out of work." —Corel resident
"So this is the power of the Warring Triad! With this and my magicite... the world will be mine to command!" —Emperor Gestahl
"The Burn"—once a verdant region teeming with flora and fauna, repeated summonings saw it bled of aether and reduced to a barren desert.
"I lived in the city of Bevelle until ten years ago. It's the biggest city in Spira! The main temple of Yevon is there." —Yuna
"The time has come for us to claim our rightful dominion over the world!" —Emperor Gestahl
Reports of bloody carnage have reached the Crystarium, and the guard has deployed in force in answer to Holminster's plea for aid.

"Deep within the Sea of Clouds, beyond treacherous winds and swirling rock, lies a land like no other. Isles-—nay, pristine jewels—clustered about a massive floating crystal." —Diadem mission commander
"Today the No. 1 Reactor was bombed. The terrorist group Avalanche has claimed responsibility for the bombing." —President Shinra
In order to reach the Sealed Gate and enter the land of the espers, one must brave a volcanic dungeon, fraught with vile monsters.
"A shining monument to corporate greed. One of these days I'm gonna tear it down and burn the rubble." —Barret Wallace
The legendary treasure sleeps where the mountains form a star.
"Thinking of crossing the marshes? Hmm, then it'll probably be safer for you to get a chocobo." —Chocobo Bill
Haunting the depths of what is now Loch Seld, Skalla's silent walls lure adventurers into the salt-laden waters with the promise of mysteries unsolved and treasures unclaimed.
"Look closely. Emet-Selch has not simply reclaimed these ruins he has layered the semblance of an entire city upon them." —Y'shtola Rhul
"Ah, our guests have arrived!" -—Aenc Thon, Lord of the Lingering Gaze
"I wish I could live in a place like this. Peaceful... living with a smile on my face every day." —Yuna
"You there! We're about to storm the castle. The two of you will join the assault squad. Get moving!" -—Imperial soldier
"Are you heading for Kilika Temple? Then just follow this trail. There are poisonous fiends in the forest. Be on your guard!" -—Crusader captain
"First down the Moonflow to the Guado city of Guadosalam... then we cross the Thunder Plains to the temple of Macalania." —Lulu
Remiem Temple. Once a great religious center in the Calm Lands, lost after the battle with Sin.
Kilika Temple is the temple of fire. Even the Cloister of Trials is engulfed in flames. Those who disobey the precepts and enter unsanctioned may forfeit their lives.
"It is better for you to die in hope than to live in despair. Let me be your liberator." —Lady Yunalesca
For years, it was not known how the pirates were able to raid areas so far from the coast, until a local shepherd sighted a band of painted ruffians entering the Sastasha Seagrot...
"Come, summoner. I will bestow you with my power: the Dark Aeon, Anima." —Seymour's mother
"Monsters instinctively target weaker prey," said Cloud. "Hmm... you'd better watch out then," Aerith teased.
"I'll show you who's the better man!" —Seifer Almasy
"Your powers even transcend Bahamut's... Alexander, I've been waiting for you." —Kuja
"I'm not here to help. I just want it to be fair."
"Dagger is more important to me than anything else."
"Gimme a pose I'll never forget!"
"No matter how dark the night, morning always comes."
"Rikku-approved item coming up!"
Nym's scholars defended their tiny nation with spell-weaving faeries.
"I have orders to infiltrate Shinra headquarters and steal their ultimate materia."
"The flowers they ... they have something important to tell us."

It is rumored that wild breeds of the species— including those which have retained the capacity for flight—still thrive throughout forests nestled in the vastly unexplored valleys of Abalathia's Spine.
"Kefka's practically a god now, sitting up in that tower of his with the power of the Warring Triad at his command..." —Albrook citizen
"Thanks to the miracle of mako energy, our lives are richer and better than ever before. Mako keeps our lights on at night, and made Midgar into the city that never sleeps." —Shinra guide
"The city lights go out one by one. The stars fade then the horizon glows, almost like it's on fire. It's really... pretty. I know you'd like it." —Tidus
